notes: Seed http://www.co.coke.tx.us/ works over https. No Clarity or vendor site; page also links the SOS 'Texas Election Night Reporting'. All three election-night files are scanned Hart cumulative (county total) reports, read visually; Last-Modified values differ per file and match the PDF scan times. Precinct-level reports were not found for these elections (the county posted a 'PRECINCT RESULTS REPORT-OFFICIAL TOTALS' only for Nov 2025). Official result files posted after the canvass were not opened. 2024 run time vs upload time mismatch noted in that election's fact.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (check 2: county totals only on election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Confidence med because the 2026 primary and runoff each have a printed run time and a server upload time on election night.

2024_general.fact: 'General Results' is a scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report OFFICIAL ELECTION RESULTS COKE COUNTY, TEXAS GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 ... Unofficial Results' with county totals by vote type only, printed 'Run Time 9:08 PM Run Date 11/05/2024'. Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 02:37:37 GMT (8:37 PM CST), PDF CreationDate 02:28:45 UTC. The printed time is later than the upload time, which suggests the tabulator clock was still on daylight time (9:08 PM CDT = 8:08 PM CST). No precinct-level 2024 general file is listed for election night.

2026_primary.fact: 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS DEMOCRAT & REPUBLICAN' (Unofficial Results.pdf) is an 18-page scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report ELECTION RESULTS COKE COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 Unofficial Results' with county totals by Absentee, Early, Election Day only, 'Run Time 8:28 PM Run Date 03/03/2026'. Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 03:08:18 GMT (9:08 PM CST). No precinct report for the primary is listed on the page.

2026_runoff.fact: 'UNOFFICIAL PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION RESULTS DEMOCRATIC & REPUBLICAN' is a scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report ELECTION RESULTS COKE COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION 5/26/2026 Unofficial Results' with county totals only, 'Run Time 7:56 PM Run Date 05/26/2026'. Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:33:54 GMT (8:33 PM CDT). No precinct report for the runoff is listed on the page.
